external.note: Background Blender (blender -b --factory-startup) runs every check, probe and render; scripts/organic_audit.py, organic_probe.py and tangent_compare.py relaunch themselves in it from host Python, finding it from --blender-exe, else --local-config FILE (tools.blender.path, the file this audit's --local-config reads), else BLENDER, else blender on PATH, else the standard install folder; the tests read BLENDER, PATH and the standard folder. The direct form needs --python-exit-code 2. Recipes and probe numbers were measured on Blender 5.1.2. Confirm version, file and scene before any live edit.
Host Python 3.9+ launches the background Blender runs and reads their JSON reports; organic_weights.py and blender_env.py are pure standard library.
Host Python package for the scripts/test_*.py suites; the Blender suites skip when no Blender is found, the pure ones run anywhere.

The consuming project supplies the target armature or bone table, its bind pose, the list of bones that may carry weight (organic_audit --allowed-bones), the test animations and a reference asset with its measurements.
The consuming project's game-file reader writes the per-vertex P/N/T/UV/I JSON that tangent_compare.py reads; this package ships no game-format reader.

Consumer-provided phase-handoff contract and writer, not bundled here. In this library it is hosted by the hard-surface texturing package: blender-architecture-texturing/references/handoff-contract.md and blender-architecture-texturing/scripts/handoff.py. That writer refuses a handoff with status review/accepted or owner_review pending unless it names primary_blend, active_scene and delivery.live_readback. A public copy of this package names the consumer's own writer.
